description:
crate-jmap-server/src/lib.rs:256-257 — every dispatched method call performs:

  let method_clone = method.clone();    // String alloc
  let call_id_clone = call_id.clone();  // String alloc

These are required because the spawned task captures by move and task::spawn needs static.
title: method/call_id clone-per-call: Arc<str> would shave allocations on hot path
